title: Zinc cofactor in human histone deacetylase 8: Requirement for function and opportunity for drug discovery.
authors: Garcia-Franco, Paula M; Falco-Marti, F Javier; Jeblaoui, Hajar; Asencio Del Rio, Marta; Ortega-Alarcon, David; Vega, Sonia; Galano-Frutos, Juan J; Abian, Olga; Velazquez-Campoy, Adrian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究HDAC8蛋白与锌辅因子的热力学稳定性，虽涉及蛋白-配体互作，但对象为酶-金属离子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: HDAC8 (histone deacetylase 8), a class I HDAC, is a promising target for different disorders: X-linked intellectual disability, fibrotic disease, cancer, and several neuropathological diseases. The structural and functional similarity between HDACs hinders the development of selective HDAC8 inhibitors. To date, no drugs based on competitive inhibition have been approved. In order to identify weaknesses in HDAC8 amenable to drug discovery, we report here a comprehensive thermodynamic characterization of the structural stability and its modulation by the interaction with its zinc (Zn(2+)) cofactor using a combination of experimental and computational techniques. HDAC8 represents an interesting example of an allosteric protein in the broad sense, in which its cofactor, the zinc ion, modulates its conformational equilibrium. The native, inactive, zinc-free state is physiologically relevant considering that the intracellular concentration of zinc is very low and may constitute a valid target for drug discovery.
abstract_zh: HDAC8（组蛋白去乙酰化酶8）是一种I类HDAC，是多种疾病的有前景靶点：X连锁智力障碍、纤维化疾病、癌症以及若干神经病理学疾病。HDACs之间的结构和功能相似性阻碍了选择性HDAC8抑制剂的开发。迄今为止，尚无基于竞争性抑制的药物获批。为了识别HDAC8中适合药物发现的弱点，我们在此报告了对其结构稳定性及其通过与锌（Zn(2+)）辅因子相互作用调节的综合热力学表征，采用实验和计算技术相结合的方法。HDAC8代表了广义上变构蛋白的一个有趣例子，其中其辅因子锌离子调节其构象平衡。天然、无活性、无锌状态在生理学上具有相关性，考虑到细胞内锌浓度非常低，可能构成药物发现的有效靶点。
